title: Master Key Generator
oneLiner: Build a master key system for pin tumbler locks in the browser: printable bitting list and pinning chart with MACS and pin stack checks
customer: Small locksmith shops, facility maintenance staff and landlords who master key their own pin tumbler locks, US first
revenueModel: Free build and preview, paid per downloadable chart or a low price unlimited pass, in USD

evidence.claim: CLK Supplies sells one emailed master key setup chart (1 master, 25 change keys, with pin list) for $10.15.
CLK Supplies sells further chart sizes, such as 1 master with 50 change keys.
Aero Key master keying software sells for $120 and runs only on Windows.
The iPhone app Master It, which creates and prints master key systems, is paid at $6.99.
The iPhone app Pin Head, a pinning calculator with MACS checks, is paid at $3.99.
HPC MasterKing master keying software sells for $340.68, on CD only.
Rabbitsoft sells FasterMaster master keying software from $95 (Lite) to $375 (II Pro) as Windows downloads, with time limited trials only.
A 2006 Lock Picking 101 forum thread on assigning key bittings has a member asking whether there is a free online site to generate these codes; nobody names one.

nextAction: Research verdict 15 Nov: KILL recommended, decision for the CEO. For: people do pay for this (8 sourced items: CLK $10.15 charts, Aero Key $120, HPC MasterKing $340.68, Rabbitsoft $95 to $375, Master It $6.99, Pin Head $3.99). Against, decisive: Key-En-Lock launched a free Master Key System Builder (22 Feb 2026, free account) for property managers, facility managers and locksmiths that already does our whole product: Schlage C, Kwikset KW1, Yale, Corbin Russwin and Best SFIC, MACS checks, anti cross keying, phantom key warnings, pinning chart and door schedule PDFs (https://keyenlock.com/blog/master-key-system-builder/). Also free: ABUS online designer with pinning and cutting data (https://www.abus.com/uk/News/Design-Masterkey-Systems-Online), a free web tool MKCalc named on a 2018 forum thread (https://www.lockpicking101.com/viewtopic.php?p=481665), Pin It Now pinning calculator free to lockcodes.com subscribers (https://lockcodes.com/), open source Masterkey on SourceForge (https://sourceforge.net/projects/masterkey/). Demand is small and old: paid apps have 7 and 19 ratings, forum requests are from 2006 to 2018, no Reddit evidence found (Reddit search blocked by the proxy). Search volume figures: null, no keyword tool available. Not moved to validated; business case, sizing and CEO decision need separate agents this session could not launch.
